channel.title: Going Eagle — golf improvement, measured
channel.description: Find out what is actually costing you strokes, then fix it. Golf instruction, short game, scoring strategy and equipment guidance, reviewed by a working golf coach.

item.title: How to Fix a Slice in Golf
item.description: A slice is an open face relative to your swing path. Here is how to confirm that is your miss, find which of the two causes is yours, and fix it in the right order.
